documentation.title: Docblock Options
documentation.standard:
Every command needs a docblock, and one with an ## OPTIONS section when it reads its arguments. WP-CLI builds "wp help" and validates the command line from it. A synopsis (or an ## OPTIONS heading in longdesc) passed to WP_CLI::add_command() counts as well. The heading must stand on its own line.
Requirement: G1 (MUST, error). Error codes: MissingDocblock, MissingOptionsSection. Properties: ignoreMethods (method names that are never commands), ignoreClasses (classes that are never command classes).

code_comparison.code: /** * Reindex posts. * * ## OPTIONS * * [--batch-size=] * : Posts per batch. */
